title: Symrise completes acquisition of Floral Concept, strengthening its position in Premium Naturals
summary: – Completion reinforces Symrise’s Premium Naturals position in fragrance – Floral Concept joins Maison Lautier 1795 in a Naturals cluster in Grasse – Combined expertise spans sourcing, transformation and fragrance creation – Acquisition supports ONE Symrise and active portfolio development

extraction.key_fact: 심라이즈가 플로럴 콘셉트 인수를 완료하며 향수 부문 프리미엄 천연 원료 입지를 강화했다.
